checks.title: Each step that uses actions/setup-python declares a runtime that GitHub Actions supports
checks.rationale: go.yml (PR CI build job) runs actions/setup-python@v3 before pre-commit/action. v3 declares the node16 runtime. GitHub removed node16 from runners and forces such actions onto a newer Node.js, and actionlint 1.7.7 reports the step as too old to run. setup-python v6 declares node24. The check runs actionlint on the worktree and keeps only the runtime findings for the updated action.
